messages:
Noah: quick preflight for the "Aurora" launch nurture — goal is a tight 2-email welcome + a webinar reminder flow for registrants. want segmentation, send windows by region, and a 7-day holdout for lift measurement. blockers?
Zara: sounds good. propose segments: webinar_reg, benchmark_dl, and partner_referrals. de-dupe by email, prefer most_recent_source.
Mika: Content plan: Email A (immediate) = welcome + 1-click benchmark snapshot; Email B (+3 days) = short playbook + demo CTA. For webinar regs add a reminder at +2 days before event.
Sam: Deliverability notes: run seed send to product@ and qa@, ensure rwd.ai DKIM/SPF, and include List-Unsubscribe header. also remove hard bounces >90d.
Zara: Send windows: NA 9-11am local, EU 10-12 CET, APAC 11am-1pm JST. Rate limit initial surge to 180/min with 10% ramp every 10m.
Noah: Measurement — 7d and 14d conversion windows. Holdout = 7% randomized per segment. Events: aurora_welcome_open, aurora_playbook_click, aurora_webinar_rsvp, aurora_demo_booked.
Mika: Subject test for Email A: A) "Your Aurora benchmark snapshot is ready" B) "Welcome 1 Start with your Redwood snapshot". Preview tests: latency-first vs cost-first.
Zara: SQL for cohort (ops use last_touch tie-breaker):
```
SELECT id, email, lead_source FROM leads
WHERE lead_source IN ('webinar_reg','benchmark_dl','partner_referral')
  AND created_at >= '2026-03-01'
  AND unsubscribed = false
  AND bounce_type != 'hard'
ORDER BY last_touch DESC
```
Sam: Ops checklist: templates in staging, personalization tokens verified, seed sends green, suppression lists applied (unsubscribed, do-not-contact, GDPR opt-outs). Backfill? we should run a separate backfill for ~900 missed regs and tag backfill=true.
Noah: Good call on separate backfill. Keep it low-rate and after main launch to avoid metric contamination.
Mika: I'll add conditional enterprise block for lead_source=partner_referral with dedicated-capacity CTA. Also include rwd.ai/aurora short link.
Zara: Analytics tags: utm_campaign=aurora-welcome, utm_source=welcome-drip, add hashed_user param for cross-system mapping. Dashboard tile for 24h open, 72h click, and 14d demo conversions. Set alert if open rate is -30% vs baseline.
ops-bot: Campaign "aurora-welcome-nurture" queued: start=1779998000, rate=180/min, segments=3, holdout=7%, backfill_job=queued.
Noah: :rocket: finalize copy by 11:30am PT, run staging seeds, and schedule if tests pass. post-launch quick sync tomorrow 9am PT to review 0-24h metrics.
